name: tunevote/php-realtime
description: Framework-agnostic, PHP-native real-time session backend: authoritative DB state + append-only event log, delta sync over long-poll/short-poll/SSE, per-session locking, presence, roles and signed tokens. No persistent Node/WebSocket process required.

suggest.ext-redis: Enables the optional Redis storage driver (pub/sub fan-out + locks) for lower latency and horizontal scaling.
